scope: Eight fresh held-out trajectories after verified stable release; no score or runtime qualification claim. Exact published source/binary config binding remains required. No model launches from this declaration.
guards: Exactly one model; no concurrent builds/GPU tests; existing byte-plan, normal/flat-swap baseline, critical/two-warning/swap/disk stops unchanged. Halt and preserve every failed or partial attempt before any next model. No retry-until-pass.
interpretation: Serving-profile comparison across releases. In particular, Ornith/Groot prior scored allocator128MiB -> currently native-qualified512MiB is explicit; new timing/score changes must not be attributed solely to source or any single patch. The separate fresh ABBA uses512MiB on BOTH release legs. Same weights, precision, context and model-card samplers/seeds otherwise retained. Two seeds do not establish confidence intervals or statistical independence.
reporting: Keep all append-only rows, separately audit complete coverage, one equal-weight repeated-run average per model, short/long throughput and task durations; no older checkpoints or selected best runs in current cohort. Preserve all historical and alternative-model evidence.
